description: This file contains JUnit test cases for the Role class in the OpenMRS project, focusing on privilege management and role hierarchy relationships.

classes.name: RoleTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for the Role class which tests privilege addition/removal, privilege checks, and role hierarchy functions.

methods.name: shouldAddRemovePrivilege
methods.description: Tests adding, duplicate handling, and removing privileges from a Role.

methods.name: hasPrivilege_shouldNotFailGivenNullParameter
methods.description: Checks that hasPrivilege handles null input gracefully.

methods.name: hasPrivilege_shouldReturnTrueIfFound
methods.description: Verifies that hasPrivilege returns true when the privilege is present.

methods.name: hasPrivilege_shouldReturnFalseIfNotFound
methods.description: Verifies that hasPrivilege returns false when the privilege is absent.

methods.name: hasPrivilege_shouldReturnTrueForAnyPrivilegeNameIfSuperUser
methods.description: Checks that superuser roles have all privileges regardless of the name.

methods.name: getAllParentRoles_shouldOnlyReturnParentRoles
methods.description: Tests retrieval of all ancestor roles in a hierarchy.

methods.name: getAllChildRoles_shouldOnlyReturnChildRoles
methods.description: Tests retrieval of all descendant roles in a hierarchy.
